result.summary: I haven't paid or forwarded the Alder & Finch invoice for £174, and I've escalated the case at high priority (queue 35). We asked the contractor for a quotation only and told him in writing not to start, but he did the work anyway. Nobody knows how he got into the empty property. The invoice is one lump sum with no breakdown, and some items go beyond the original repairs. I've asked the contractor for the details we need, told the landlord the invoice is on hold, and set a 2-day follow-up.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved the remedial works with no cost stated (ev 005), but the agency asked Alder & Finch for a quote only and said no work until written authority (ev 007/008). The contractor says he did the work anyway on 9 Sep (ev 013). Invoice NBL-019-INV-11 is a single £174 line with no itemised breakdown, VAT, work date or payment terms. It also includes replacements that weren't authorised: a floorboard plus carpet reinstatement, and a new Venetian blind. The property is vacant and the agency held the keys, so how he got in is a security question. The rules say an invoice that doesn't match an approved quote gets escalated, not paid. Jev also flagged the invoice for review (needs a human response: 0.84).

alternatives_considered.option: Forward the invoice to the landlord for payment and move to close-out
alternatives_considered.why_not: No price or scope was ever agreed, the work went ahead against our written instruction, and nothing proves it was done.
How he got into the empty property and whether the work was unauthorised both need a staff decision. The landlord also needs to know the invoice is on hold.
The landlord did approve the works in general, so whether to accept the invoice is a decision for agency staff and the landlord.

checks_performed: Read the invoice: correct property and contractor, £174 lump sum, no itemised breakdown, VAT or work date
Checked approvals: no amount approved and no approval record in the CRM
Compared the invoiced scope with the inspection items: the floorboard and blind were replaced, not repaired
Checked access: tenant gone, agency holds the keys, no access arrangement on file
Looked for completion evidence: none visible
assumptions: The landlord's general approval did not authorise any price without a quote, since the agency made the quote a condition (ev 007/008)

escalation.recommendation: Confirm the property is secure and check the key log. Get the work verified. Decide with the landlord whether to accept the invoice. Check whether any costs can be recovered from the former tenant's deposit.
